description: Audio Cues system (Web Audio API), Accent Color Customization, Dark Mode Refinement, and Section-specific Skeleton Screens - Add subtle audio feedback, user-selectable accent colors, thoughtful dark mode tuning, and custom skeleton layouts per page section.
steps: Create frontend/src/hooks/useAudioCue.ts - a lightweight hook using Web Audio API (OscillatorNode + GainNode) to play very short, subtle tones. Expose playClick() (soft 1200Hz sine, 40ms, gain 0.08), playSuccess() (ascending 800->1200Hz, 80ms, gain 0.06), playNotification() (gentle 900Hz, 60ms, gain 0.07). Respect a global muted preference stored in localStorage. Must pass strict TS with proper typing.

Create frontend/src/hooks/useAccentColor.ts - a small Zustand store (persisted to localStorage) that holds the user's chosen accent color from a preset list (blue/teal/purple/rose/amber/emerald). On mount, inject a <style> tag or set CSS custom properties (--accent, --accent-hover, --accent-soft, --accent-border, --accent-fg) on document.documentElement. Provide a setAccentColor(color) action and a getAccentColors() helper returning the preset list.

Add accent color picker UI to DashboardCustomizer.tsx - below the widget reorder section, add a 'Theme Color' section showing 6 color circles. Clicking one calls setAccentColor(). Show a checkmark on the active color. Keep TypeScript strict-safe.
Add audio toggle to DashboardCustomizer.tsx - a single checkbox row 'Sound Effects' that toggles the audio muted state from the useAudioCue hook store.
Wire audio cues into the app: In OasisWidget.tsx, play playClick() on message send. In Sidebar.tsx nav items, no audio needed (too frequent). In DashboardCustomizer.tsx, play playClick() on open.

Dark mode refinement in global-icon.css: Add [data-theme='dark'] overrides that (a) slightly warm up pure blacks to #0f1117 -> already done, (b) add subtle gradient noise texture overlay on --bg for depth, (c) boost card borders to have a faint colored inner-glow, (d) ensure glassmorphism blur values are stronger in dark for better contrast, (e) add a very subtle vignette effect on .content via radial-gradient overlay.

Section-specific skeletons: In frontend/src/components/primitives/States.tsx, add DashboardSkeleton (mimics stat tiles + GPA ring + agenda layout), CourseSkeleton (grid of course cards), and LectureSkeleton (video placeholder + sidebar). Use the existing Skeleton primitive. Each should have shimmer animation via the existing .skeleton-shimmer class from world-class.css.
acceptance_criteria: useAudioCue.ts compiles cleanly with strict TS and produces no runtime errors when called in a non-browser context (guard typeof window)
useAccentColor.ts persists choice to localStorage and applies CSS variables on document root
DashboardCustomizer shows color picker circles and sound toggle without breaking existing functionality
OasisWidget plays a subtle click sound on send (when audio enabled)
Dark mode has enhanced depth with subtle gradients and noise texture
New skeleton components (DashboardSkeleton, CourseSkeleton, LectureSkeleton) render without errors
